Overview

Sochi is a city in Krasnodar Krai with a population of 445,000. Russia’s premier Black Sea resort, host of the 2014 Winter Olympics, with a subtropical climate, beautiful beaches, and mountain ski resorts. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
